verdict.rationale: The docs say crypto is accepted by enabling the Crypto payment method in an existing Stripe integration. Payments settle as fiat in the Stripe balance, and Stripe handles conversion and payout. Onramp options (hosted page, embedded web, mobile SDK) and an llms.txt note about installing Stripe packages point to conventional SDK-based integration with no node operation by the developer. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that gas fees and chain mechanics are abstracted away, crypto-specific REST API reference or per-language client library coverage, and independent hands-on corroboration of the developer experience.
